title: Tu padhta jaa qur\'aan
body:
Tu padhta jaa qur\'aan
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere majaye teri zainab ki chadar tujhpar qurbaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Har simt tamashayi hai khade, meri aankhein hai hairaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Himmat de, sabr de, taqat de
allah mere bhai tujhko
tu sura e kahf jo padhta hai
sunte hai tamashayi tujhko
bat jaata hai kuch pal ke liye, kufe walo ka dhyaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai dil mein mere bus ek chubhan
mai kaun hu koi jaan na le
baalo'n se chipaye hu chehra
kahin koi mujhe pehchaan na le
lekin ye hai zehra ka kunba, koi karta hai ailaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kis haal mein hai teri maa jayi
zara dekh to le mujhe naize se
meri pusht hai durro se chalni
mere shano par hai neel pade
kal tak mai jahan shehzaadi thi, wahi aaj hai meri ye shaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hame zalim patthar marte hai
sadqo ki khajure phaik te hai
azaad kiya tha humne jinhe
wahi aaj tamasha dekhte hai
jis simt nigaah uthati hu, meri maut ke hai samaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hum apne shikasta kaandho par
sou(100) karbobalaye leke chale
ye zulm bhi koi kam to nahi
ek rassi hai aur 12 gale
meri khatir rabb se maang dua, mujhe jaana hai zindaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ghaazi ka alam mere saath me hai
akbar ki azaa'n mere saath me hai
hai shaam e ghareeba aankho me
khaimo ka dhua mere saath me hai
pardes mein humko ummat ne, kya khoob rakha mehmaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mere phool mere nauras gunche
hai aaj sina ki shakho'n par
wo qasim o akbar ke sar hai
wo aun o mohammad wo asghar
taqdeer ne khoob sajaye hai, naizo pe mere armaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Awaaz ka parda reh jaye
bolungi ali ke lehje mein
sab dekhle baate karti hai
zainab bhi wali ke lehje mein
miljayega teri tilawat se, mere khutbo ko unwaan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sajjad ke dil se puche koi
hai kaisi qayamat ki ye ghadi
hatho me hai jiske hathkadiya
payro mein hai dohri bedi padi
<<DIVIDER>>
beemar ne langar pehna hai, insaaf kare insaan
10. Aye nayyar o amir aati hai
reh reh ke azakhano se sadaa
zainab ki tamanna hai matam aur aasu hai zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham tera pohchayenge, ghar ghar tere nauhakhwan
<<MINI>>
tu padhta jaa qur'aan..(4)
